title: A Terminal for the Echo
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: Freya Lockridge, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
